summary.description: Compounds consisting of a tin molecule bound to an organic compound, with chemical-specific properties. Dibutyltin chloride is an example.
emission_sources: Industrial use of organotin compounds (e.g., plastics strengthening agents, marine pesticides, preservatives)
Small natural releases from the Earth's crust
environmental_impact: Long-term occupational exposure can cause irritation and breathing difficulties
Accumulate in marine environments, concentrating in fish and through the food chain
No known significant global environmental impacts

top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Organotins accumulate in marine environments and bio-concentrate in fish, posing risks to aquatic ecosystems and biodiversity.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Long-term occupational exposure to organotins can cause respiratory issues and irritation, impacting worker health.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG12_Responsible_Consumption_and_Produc: Industrial use and release of organotin compounds highlight the need for sustainable production and safer chemical management.
